text:
auditor_mark: Morning team Quick ask for our ISO/SOC audit tomorrow: we need evidence for RBAC changes (90-day window), proof of PR approval flow, service-account deprovision events, any KMS key access tied to those changes, and the vuln tickets that triggered changes. Can you confirm deliverables and a drop time?

olivia_secops: We can compile. Prefer a digestible CSV + one fully traced example (PR -> CI deploy -> k8s audit event -> KMS key event). Also include a short control mapping note (ISO A.9.2 and SOC2 CC6.2).

dan_oncall: I'll export rolebinding deltas from the Git repo and produce a CSV with cols: pr_id, committer, approver, cluster, binding_name, principals_added, principals_removed, rationale_jira. ETA 4:30pm ET.

jake_infra: For runtime evidence I will pull kube-apiserver audit entries and the cloud KMS logs. Example Splunk query for apiserver: 

```splunk
index=apiserver source="kube_audit" "RoleBinding" OR "ClusterRoleBinding"
| where _time >= relative_time(now(), "-90d@d")
| eval pr_id = mvindex(request.objectRef.annotations.pr, 0)
| table _time host user verb objectRef.name objectRef.namespace pr_id requestID
```

jake_infra: And GCP KMS log snippet (Stackdriver filter) I'll use for CMEK: 

"resource.type=cloud_kms_key AND protoPayload.methodName:("Encrypt" OR "Decrypt" OR "GenerateRandom") AND timestamp>="-90d""

olivia_secops: For AWS KMS keys we can use Athena on CloudTrail parquet similar to previous queries; include eventName IN (GenerateDataKey, Decrypt, Encrypt) and filter by keyId list.

auditor_mark: Good. One more: we need proof that service accounts removed are no longer active (token usage / lastAuth). If deprov happened, include token invalidation logs or list of removed keys.

dan_oncall: Will add last_active timestamp from our auth telemetry and any service-account key deletions from IAM. If a SA was rotated instead of deleted we'll mark that and include rotation ticket.

jake_infra: Uploading a preliminary evidence bundle to presigned link: https://evidence.redwood.example/signed/ef12gh34 (valid 48h). It contains: rolebinding_changes.csv, traced_example/ (PR screenshots + pipeline run), kube_audit_snippets.txt, kms_events.csv, control_mapping_short.pdf, README.txt.

ci-bot: pipeline run 2812346789-trace-example completed: status=success, artifacts=traced_example/build-log.txt :white_check_mark:

olivia_secops: For vuln crosswalk: one RBAC tightening stems from ticket JIRA: SEC-4600 (service account privilege escalation finding). I'll include the triage notes and remediation summary (2-3 lines). Other changes unrelated to vuln will be marked N/A.

auditor_mark: Please ensure timestamps are ISO8601 and timezone-aware so we can match logs across systems. Also include a short README listing primary contacts and steps to reproduce the correlation if we want to validate.

dan_oncall: README will have contacts olivia_secops and dan_oncall and a short mapping doc explaining filename <-> control. Delivering final zip by 16:30 ET (zipped to evidence-drop/2812346789_audit_bundle.zip).

jake_infra: Confirmed upload to evidence-drop and shared to audit mailbox.

auditor_mark: Thanks team I'll download and spot-check tonight. If I find gaps I'll post questions in this thread. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
